heroHeading: Studio-grade video podcasts <br class="hidden sm:inline" />filmed in *your own boardroom.*
heroLead: Senior leadership rarely has time to travel to an external recording studio. We bring cinema cameras, acoustic mics, and studio lighting directly to your boardroom, recording a month of episodic content in a single afternoon.
breakdownHeading: Broadcast production configured for *your meeting room.*
breakdownBody: We turn your meeting room into an executive recording space within minutes. Our agile production crews configure multiple camera angles, manage sound levels, and guide discussions so leadership looks composed, sounds natural, and stays focused entirely on the conversation.

deliverables.title: Multi-Camera Master Episodes
deliverables.description: Multi-angle narrative cuts with smooth camera switching, branded graphics, and calibrated audio mastering, ready for YouTube, Spotify Video, and internal company channels.

deliverables.title: Vertical Social & LinkedIn Cutdowns
deliverables.description: High-impact vertical 9:16 clips with styled burned-in captions, spotlighting key executive insights to build reach and discussion across LinkedIn feeds.

deliverables.title: Mastered Audio Feeds for RSS
deliverables.description: Pristine vocal tracks with ambient noise reduction and loudness mastering, delivered ready for instant RSS feed distribution across Apple Podcasts and Spotify.

ctaHeading: Planning an executive podcast or *interview series?*
